items.title: Intro con logo
items.description: Logo stamp pops on a lined board, a kicker line gives way to the title with an accent arrow chip; seeded line distortion

items.title: Título prisma
items.description: Display title on a transparent root: blur-focus entrance, red/blue fringe that settles then breathes, perspective bow, slow scale drift

items.title: Onda tipográfica
items.description: A crest of thickness travels along a headline: each character swells from light to black and leans forward as the wave passes, driven by the wght and slnt variable-font axes rather than by transforms.

items.title: Panel de aeropuerto
items.description: Solari-style departure board: every cell walks its drum forward through the intervening characters of a fixed alphabet until it lands on its target, so the text resolves as a mechanical cascade instead of a fade.

items.title: Título manuscrito
items.description: Handwritten display text with a scalar-driven word-by-word highlight sweep and a seeded squiggle underline sized to the text; boils

items.title: Título que se escribe
items.description: True glyph write-on: filled Caveat letterforms revealed by baked per-glyph centerline strokes traced in real stroke order with a curvature-adaptive pen-velocity ease (fast on straights, slow into curves, inter-stroke pen lifts); optional squiggle underline; boils

items.title: Texto en trayectoria
items.description: Handwriting flowing along any SVG path with a per-character reveal; the path is the only geometry input

items.title: Frase resaltada
items.description: A sentence whose word-by-word emphasis is driven by a single scalar — tween it to sync the highlight with a voiceover

items.title: Rótulo borde neón
items.description: Two arcs of light travel the edge of a rounded panel and snap corner to corner, trailing a soft three-layer bloom. A lower third for a name and role.

items.title: Rótulo subrayado
items.description: Cardless lower third for footage overlay: name rises, an accent rule draws left-to-right, role fades in; text-shadowed for legibility

items.title: Rótulo bloque
items.description: High-energy podcast lower third: solid dark block wipes in, uppercase name slams up, accent tag pops

items.title: Rótulo barra limpia
items.description: Minimal white-card lower third for podcasts/interviews: accent tab, name + role, clip-wipe entrance

items.title: Rótulo color
items.description: High-energy lower third: bold accent-color block slides in with overshoot, condensed name + mono role

items.title: Rótulo tarjeta oscura
items.description: Charcoal card lower third for bright footage: name, drawn accent underline, role; slide-up entrance

items.title: Rótulo con etiqueta
items.description: Cardless lower third with an accent eyebrow/kicker tag, heavy name, and a drawn baseline; for footage

items.title: Rótulo con máscara
items.description: Cardless lower third: an accent sweep crosses and clip-path-reveals a heavy name, role fades up; for footage

items.title: Rótulo línea lateral
items.description: Cardless lower third with a vertical accent bar; condensed display name + mono role, text-shadowed for footage

items.title: Rótulo píldora
items.description: Rounded white pill lower third for podcasts/interviews: status dot, name + role, scale-pop entrance

items.title: Rótulo barras
items.description: Two stacked bars: a dark name bar wipes from the left, an accent role bar wipes from the right

items.title: Rótulo exclusiva
items.description: News-style lower third with tight-fit text boxes: white headline bar with red drop-shadow, red sub-line with white drop-shadow.

items.title: Rótulo creador
items.description: Animated YouTube subscribe lower third with avatar and channel info

items.title: Noticias de última hora
items.description: Premium broadcast-style lower-third ticker with live label, headline ribbon, and scrolling news crawl.

items.title: Botón seguir (vertical)
items.description: Animated TikTok follow overlay with profile card and follow button

items.title: Seguir perfil (vertical)
items.description: Animated Instagram follow overlay with profile card and follow button

items.title: Publicación social
items.description: Animated X/Twitter post card overlay with engagement metrics

items.title: Publicación de foro
items.description: Animated Reddit post card overlay with upvotes and comments

items.title: Comentarios
items.description: Social comments typing on over footage: avatar pop, username and time, per-character typewriter, likes row; image avatars or initials chips

items.title: Notificación
items.description: Animated macOS-style notification banner with app icon and message

items.title: Conversación
items.description: A source-owned editable conversation stack with arbitrary incoming and outgoing messages

items.title: Videocámara REC
items.description: Responsive REC, battery, editable date placeholder, and timeline-driven counter overlay for creator-camera and camcorder treatments

items.title: Flash editorial
items.description: Finite neutral-warm light layers for a seek-safe camera-flash cut or social reveal

items.title: Fuga de luz orgánica
items.description: Finite CSS light-leak overlay for memory beats and motivated transitions

items.title: Recorte scrapbook
items.description: Timeline-driven paper, tape, and flash dressing for a freeze-frame or background-removed subject

items.title: Marco manuscrito
items.description: Media in a hand-drawn border with corner doodles and a handwritten caption; the unit tilts slightly and boils (images inside the block; keep live footage in the host)

items.title: Bocadillo manuscrito
items.description: Hand-drawn speech bubble with a positionable tail: outline draws on, paper fill fades in, handwritten text types per character; boils

items.title: Diagrama a mano
items.description: Wobbled boxes with handwritten labels joined by curved connectors, drawing on in sequence from a node list

items.title: Nieve
items.description: Seek-safe falling-snow overlay: sparse or dense flakes drift down with size, speed and opacity correlated per flake for depth, radial-masked so the frame center stays clear

variables.label: Fall speed
variables.description: How fast flakes fall and sway.

items.title: Cielo estrellado
items.description: Seek-safe night-sky overlay: sparse or dense stars in three size tiers that twinkle and drift in two parallax layers, radial-masked to keep the frame center clear

items.title: Garabato
items.description: Overlay transition: scribble bands accumulate to cover the frame with a solid backstop, the host cuts beneath, and the scribble clears

items.title: Muro de palabras
items.description: Overlay transition: a tiled word wall covers the frame, inverts via difference blending, and clears — hard-cut the content beneath while covered

items.title: División líquida
items.description: A dot splits into a three-dot menu with a gooey metaball neck, spins into a swirl mark under directional shutter motion blur, then breaks back into three dots and merges into one. The goo is an SVG blur-and-threshold filter on the dots; the blur integrates each part along its real trajectory, so the smear follows the direction and speed of the spin.

items.title: Degradado suave
items.description: Procedural soft-blob gradient backdrop in a minimalist presentation style: two radial blobs drifting over a base color, with an animatable rounded-card bar mask and optional frosted-glass mode

items.title: Pantalla LCD
items.description: Textured paper board: scanlines with slow drift, optional pixel grid, static grain, and display text with a blur-focus entrance and chromatic-fringe title

items.title: Campo de semitonos
items.description: A full-bleed halftone light field: a grid of dots whose size and colour track a slow flowing simplex-noise field, so broad bands of light sweep across a mostly-black frame like a giant LED wall showing a plasma. Built to run under type.

items.title: Orbe cósmico
items.description: An iridescent soap-bubble planet: a slowly spinning sphere of nebula bands, dust lanes and twinkling stars wrapped in a refracting glass limb with chromatic aberration at the edge.

items.title: Galaxia espiral
items.description: A spiral galaxy seen from outside, turning with real differential rotation: inner stars orbit faster than outer ones, so the arms wind up over the shot instead of spinning rigidly. 20,000 additive GPU sprites, seeded once and solved directly from time, so any frame can be rendered on its own.

items.title: Destellos anamórficos
items.description: A drifting field of bright points, each one throwing the long horizontal blue-violet streak a real anamorphic cinema lens produces. Built from the measured filter constants: a 0.3 high-pass, 80 horizontal taps at quarter resolution, a samples/3 gain and a 0x7a8aff tint.

items.title: Bokeh con cambio de foco
items.description: A focus pull with real aperture bokeh: the focal plane travels from a near subject to a far one, so one resolves as the other blows into hard-edged polygon discs that clip to a cat's eye toward the corners. A focus pull only reads against content at two clearly separated depths, so this block carries its own depth-layered night exterior and puts both subject depths on variables.

variables.label: Cat eye clipping at the corners

items.title: Osciloscopio
items.description: CRT oscilloscope beam sweeping a waveform across a 10x8 graticule, with closed-form phosphor persistence: the tail decays as exp(-age/tau) and brightens where the beam slows

items.title: Carrera de barras
items.description: Ranked bars grow and overtake each other as a time series advances, with the axis rescaling as values climb and the accent handing over to whoever leads

variables.label: Series (one per line: Name: v1, v2, ...)

items.title: Gráfico de columnas
items.description: Animated bar + line chart with staggered reveal, NYT-style typography, and value labels

items.title: Gráfico de líneas
items.description: One or two SVG series draw on with dots popping and value labels riding the draw front; dim baseline axis, x-labels, color-dot legend

items.title: Estadística
items.description: Big-numeral statistic with count-up, label, thin progress track filling to value/max, and caption; light and dark schemes

items.title: Lista de especificaciones
items.description: Left-aligned specs/traits checklist over footage or a board: rows slide in staggered with an accent underline sweep; light and dark schemes

items.title: Diagrama de flujo
items.description: Animated decision tree with SVG connectors, sticky-note nodes, cursor interaction, and typing correction

items.title: Personaje caminando
items.description: A jointed flat character walks in on planted feet, stops and points at a card; the body acting is a Lottie file and the stage is GSAP.

variables.label: Card text
variables.default: Walks in on planted feet, then points the way.
